facts.statement: During 2024-25, foreign portfolio investment (FPI) registered a net inflow of US$ 1.7 billion.
facts.subject: foreign portfolio investment (FPI)
facts.evidence_quote: During 2024-25, foreign portfolio investment (FPI) registered a net inflow amounting to US$ 1.7 billion

facts.statement: During the previous year, foreign portfolio investment (FPI) registered a net inflow of US$ 41.6 billion.
facts.subject: foreign portfolio investment (FPI)
facts.evidence_quote: as compared to net inflows of US$ 41.6 billion during the previous year

facts.statement: The debt segment witnessed steady FPI inflows amounting to US$ 17.4 billion during 2024-25.
facts.subject: debt segment FPI inflows
facts.evidence_quote: The debt segment witnessed steady FPI inflows amounting to US$ 17.4 billion

facts.statement: Equity FPI flows recorded net outflows of US$ 15.7 billion during 2024-25.
facts.subject: Equity FPI flows
facts.evidence_quote: Equity FPI flows, however, recorded net outflows of US$ 15.7 billion during the same period

facts.statement: Equity FPI flows recorded net inflows of US$ 25.3 billion in 2023-24.
facts.subject: Equity FPI flows
facts.evidence_quote: as against net inflows of US$ 25.3 billion in 2023-24

facts.statement: As at end-March 2025, 15.7 per cent of the limits in central government securities (G-secs) were utilised by FPIs.
facts.subject: central government securities (G-secs) limits
facts.evidence_quote: As at end-March 2025, 15.7 per cent of the limits in central government securities (G-secs) were utilised

facts.statement: As at end-March 2024, 18.5 per cent of the limits in central government securities (G-secs) were utilised by FPIs.
facts.subject: central government securities (G-secs) limits

facts.statement: As at end-March 2025, 7.1 per cent of the total value of specified central G-secs opened for non-resident investors under the fully accessible route (FAR) were held by FPIs.
facts.subject: specified central G-secs under the fully accessible route (FAR)
facts.evidence_quote: Of the total value of specified central G-secs opened for non-resident investors under the fully accessible route (FAR), 7.1 per cent were held by FPIs as at end-March 2025

facts.statement: As at end-March 2024, 4.5 per cent of the total value of specified central G-secs opened for non-resident investors under the fully accessible route (FAR) were held by FPIs.
facts.subject: specified central G-secs under the fully accessible route (FAR)
facts.evidence_quote: up from 4.5 per cent as at end-March 2024.

facts.statement: During 2024-25, net ECB inflows to India were US$ 18.7 billion.
facts.subject: net ECB inflows to India
facts.evidence_quote: During 2024-25, net ECB inflows to India rose significantly to US$ 18.7 billion

facts.statement: During 2023-24, net ECB inflows to India were US$ 3.6 billion.
facts.subject: net ECB inflows to India

facts.statement: The share of rupee denominated loans and bonds in the total agreement amount stood at 5.0 per cent during 2024-25.
facts.subject: rupee denominated loans and bonds
facts.evidence_quote: The share of rupee denominated loans and bonds in the total agreement amount stood at 5.0 per cent during 2024-25

facts.statement: The share of rupee denominated loans and bonds in the total agreement amount stood at 5.3 per cent during 2023-24.
facts.subject: rupee denominated loans and bonds
facts.evidence_quote: as compared with 5.3 per cent a year ago.

facts.statement: Of the total ECB agreement amount during 2024-25, 67.6 per cent was explicitly hedged.
facts.subject: ECB agreement amount
facts.evidence_quote: Of the total ECB agreement amount during 2024-25, 67.6 per cent was explicitly hedged

facts.statement: Of the total ECB agreement amount during 2024-25, 5.2 per cent was from FDI parent companies (excluding INR loans).
facts.subject: ECB agreement amount
facts.predicate: percentage from FDI parent companies (excluding INR loans)
facts.evidence_quote: 5.2 per cent was from FDI parent companies (excluding INR loans)

facts.statement: Of the total ECB agreement amount during 2024-25, 5.0 per cent was denominated in the INR.
facts.subject: ECB agreement amount
facts.evidence_quote: and 5.0 per cent was denominated in the INR.

facts.statement: Of the total ECB agreement amount during 2024-25, 22.3 per cent comprised other ECBs.
facts.subject: ECB agreement amount
facts.evidence_quote: The remaining 22.3 per cent comprised other ECBs
